description: This file defines an OverlayPanelFactory enum with static methods for creating, animating, presenting, and dismissing overlay panels/windows in a macOS application. It manages the appearance and behavior of overlay windows, including animations and event monitoring.

methods.name: makePanel
methods.description: Creates and configures a new NSPanel with specified properties such as size, shadow, and mouse events acceptance.

methods.name: animatePresent
methods.description: Animates the presentation of a window from a start frame to a target frame with fade-in effect.

methods.name: animateFrame
methods.description: Animates resizing/movement of a window to a specified frame.

methods.name: applyFrame
methods.description: Sets the window's frame directly or with animation based on the 'animate' flag.

methods.name: present
methods.description: Presents a window with optional initial animation or immediate display, executing specific callbacks based on presentation state.

methods.name: animateDismiss
methods.description: Animates the dismissal of a window with offset and fade-out effect, then calls a completion handler.

methods.name: animateDismissAndHide
methods.description: Animates window dismissal and then hides the window, executing an 'onHidden' callback.

methods.name: clearGlobalEventMonitor
methods.description: Removes an event monitor if it exists.
